description: This file contains functions and templates for converting between different Unicode string encodings, including UTF-8, UTF-16, and ASCII, with utility functions for appending code points and performing conversions.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 encoded string to UTF-16.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 encoded string to UTF-8.

methods.name: ASCIIToUTF16
methods.description: Converts an ASCII string to UTF-16.

methods.name: UTF16ToASCII
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 string to ASCII.
